mapper.select: SELECT FROM platform_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status='PENDING' AND available_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND event_type IN #{t} ORDER BY available_at,event_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM platform_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND available_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_event SET status='DELIVERED' WHERE event_id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE platform_event SET attempts=attempts+1,status=IF(attempts>=5,'ISOLATED','PENDING'),available_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{delay},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE event_id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM platform_event WHERE status='PENDING' AND available_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND tenant_id>#{after} AND event_type IN #{t} ORDER BY tenant_id LIMIT 4
SELECT event_id,event_type,aggregate_id,status,attempts,available_at FROM platform_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id>#{after} ORDER BY event_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_event SET status='PENDING',attempts=0,available_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id=#{id} AND status='ISOLATED'
